targets.authors: McElree B., Foraker S., Dyer L.
targets.title: Memory structures that subserve sentence comprehension
targets.outcome_quote:
Both of our experiments demonstrate the signature pattern of direct-access retrieval: variation in accuracy based on dependency distance, but constant retrieval speed when a distal constituent is required to complete a long-distance dependency. Our results replicate previous findings that suggest that a direct-access retrieval mechanism supports online parsing operations (McElree et al.,
2003
; see also McElree,
2000
; Martin and McElree,
2008
,
2009
,
2011
; Van Dyke and McElree,
2011
).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The general discussion gives an overall replication verdict for the signature retrieval pattern in both experiments. The see-also citations are supporting literature, not separately retested original experiments.
